criteria.description: States the objective of replacing GUIslice's single-bounding-box invalidation model with a bounded multi-region dirty-rectangle manager wired through the partial-redraw path.
States the requirement that the SDL1 display driver updates only the individual active regions with one update per region, even when a single active region covers the whole display.
States the requirement that whole-display-only display drivers such as SDL2 keep presenting the whole display unchanged.
Records that `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_PageRedrawCalc` forces a full-page redraw when an element lacks `GSLC_ELEM_FEA_FILL_EN` even with `bRedrawPartialEn` enabled.
Records that `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_SetStackPage` calls `gslc_InvalidateRgnPage` when changing stack pages.
Records that `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_ElemSetRect` calls `gslc_InvalidateRgnAdd` for the old rectangle before updating `pElem->rElem`.
Records that `src/GUIslice.h` defines `nDispW` as `uint16_t`.
Records that `src/GUIslice_drv_sdl.c::gslc_DrvSetClipRect` delegates to `SDL_SetClipRect` under `DRV_DISP_SDL1`.
Records that `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_ElemSetVisible` calls `gslc_InvalidateRgnAdd` on `pElem->rElem` when hiding an element (`bVisible == false`).
Records that `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_CollectEvent` propagates `GSLC_EVT_DRAW` to every element reference in `pCollect->asElemRef` via `gslc_ElemEvent`.
Records that `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_PageFlipGo` calls `gslc_DrvPageFlipNow` only when `pGui->bScreenNeedFlip` is true.
Records that `src/GUIslice_drv_sdl.c` sets `pGui->bRedrawPartialEn` to `true` under `DRV_DISP_SDL1`.
Records that `examples/linux/Makefile` selects the display backend via the `GSLC_DRV` parameter.
Records the planned design of adding an internal hold flag in `gslc_tsGui` so `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_ElemSetRedraw` returns early on `GSLC_REDRAW_NONE` during every region pass except the last.
Records the planned reordering of `gslc_InvalidateRgnReset` after `gslc_PageFlipGo` in `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_PageRedrawGo` so active regions remain populated during screen presentation.
Explains that storing a redraw snapshot in spare bits 8 and 9 of `eElemFlags` was rejected because `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_SetElemRefFlag` truncates flags to `uint8_t`.
Records that the agent rejected variable-length arrays (VLAs) based on its reasoning that the codebase targets C89/C++.
Records the planned invariant in `src/GUIslice.c` that `bInvalidateEn` is true if and only if `nInvalidateRgnCnt > 0`.
Records the planned placement of the `#ifndef GSLC_INVALIDATE_RGN_MAX` default in `src/GUIslice.h` right after `#include "GUIslice_config.h"`.
Records that `src/GUIslice_drv_sdl.c` creates the SDL1 screen surface via `SDL_SetVideoMode` with `SDL_SWSURFACE | SDL_FULLSCREEN`.
Records the planned choice in `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_InvalidateRgnGet` to copy active regions into a local stack buffer and insertion-sort them rather than keeping the internal array sorted.
Records the planned snapshot in `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_PageRedrawGo` into a local `asRgn[GSLC_INVALIDATE_RGN_MAX]` array via `gslc_InvalidateRgnGet` before iterating regions.
Records the planned use of `uint32_t` area arithmetic in `src/GUIslice.c` for forced-merge wasted-area minimization under the signed 16-bit edge assumption.
Records the planned removal of the redundant trailing `pGui->bInvalidateEn = true` statement in `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_InvalidateRgnPage` so empty page bounds are not force-enabled.
Records the agent's reasoning that `src/GUIslice_drv_sdl.c::gslc_DrvDrawBkgnd` honors the active SDL1 clip rectangle when calling `gslc_DrvPasteSurface`.
Records that no code changes have been made to the repository yet.
Specifies implementing `gslc_InvalidateRgnCoalesce` in `src/GUIslice.c` as a pending implementation step.
Specifies updating the `DBG_REDRAW` diagnostics in `src/GUIslice.c::gslc_PageRedrawGo` that reference `rInvalidateRect` as a pending implementation step.
Contains at most 31200 characters.
Specifies compiling with `gcc` against the installed `libsdl1.2-dev` headers in the Linux environment as a pending verification step.
Keeps the outstanding implementation steps together so pending work is directly findable.
States that `malloc` will be used to allocate the active invalidation region array in `src/GUIslice.c`.
States that `GSLC_INVALIDATE_RGN_MAX` cannot be overridden by a user configuration header.
States that spare `eElemFlags` bits 8 and 9 were chosen to snapshot pending redraw flags.
